Name: Sirfetch'd in your farm
Author: DellMod21
Description:
I really liked the Sirfetch'd pokemon, when I saw that they hadn't made a mod to put it in Stardew Valley, I decided to create this mod
I stress again that this is only a Modification of the "White Ducks" mod of Merc931, since I only added the details of Sirfetch'd to his white ducks, all credits to Merc931
